title: A cleaner view: the last HUD buttons move into the Navigator
items: Start / Jaunts, the pace button and the light or dark switch have left the top of the screen, so more of the town shows, above all on a phone.
Jaunts, Go to and Free roam are all in the Navigator's Jaunts app.
Your pace is chosen in Move, and light or dark is in Settings, under View.
The street name now appears for about two seconds when you cross onto a new street, then fades.
